prompt: Add explicit return type annotations to all public exported functions in the src/ directory, per the project's type writing rules.
criterion: All exported functions have explicit return type annotations, no public function relies on inferred return types.

prompt: Update all test cases to use vi.fn() and vi.spyOn() for mocks instead of mocking entire modules, per the project's testing rules.
criterion: No test mocks entire modules, all mocks use vi.fn() or vi.spyOn(), test suite passes with the new mock setup.

prompt: If the project uses ESLint instead of Biome, install and configure @typescript-eslint/recommended-type-checked to work with the project's TypeScript setup.
criterion: ESLint is configured with @typescript-eslint/recommended-type-checked, running pnpm lint catches type-related lint errors correctly.

prompt: Rename all incorrectly named TypeScript files in src/ that use camelCase or PascalCase to kebab-case, per the project naming convention.
criterion: All .ts files in src/ use kebab-case naming, no camelCase or PascalCase source file names remain.

prompt: Replace all enum declarations in the codebase with as const object + typeof patterns, removing runtime enum overhead.
criterion: No enum keywords remain in the codebase, all former enum usages work with the new as const object pattern.

prompt: Add a pnpm build script to package.json that compiles the TypeScript project to the correct output directory, using the configured ES2022 target and ESM module settings.
criterion: pnpm build runs successfully, output files are valid ESM modules targeting ES2022, no build errors are present.

prompt: Configure Biome as the project's lint and formatter, set it to use 2-space indentation, no semicolons, single quotes, and trailing commas set to all.
criterion: biome.json has all required formatting rules configured, running pnpm lint and pnpm format produce no changes to compliant files.

prompt: Replace all object structure type definitions with interface, and use type only for union, intersection, and utility types as per the project rules.
criterion: All object structure definitions use interface, type is only used for union, intersection, and utility types, no misused type/interface declarations.

prompt: Set the TypeScript target in tsconfig.json to ES2022, enabling use of modern APIs like structuredClone and Array.at() in the codebase.
criterion: tsconfig target is set to ES2022, build script runs successfully, modern APIs are available in the build output.

prompt: Configure package.json to use ESM by adding "type": "module", and update tsconfig.json to set module to ESNext and moduleResolution to bundler.
criterion: package.json has "type": "module", tsconfig has correct module and moduleResolution values, project runs without module errors.
